title: The Finance Act, 2026
gazette: Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II—Section 1, No. 9, New Delhi, 30 March 2026
in_force: assented 2026-03-30; most provisions from 2026-04-01 (s.1(2)). Sets income-tax rates for the assessment year 2026-27 under the Income-tax Act, 1961 (s.2, First Schedule Part I-A) and for the tax year 2026-27 under the Income-tax Act, 2025 (s.3, Part I-B), TDS/advance-tax rates (Parts II and III), and amends the 2025 Act
converter: gaz2txt.py --margins (legalese commons, 2026-10-19; pdfplumber 0.11.10 char-level extraction for gaz2txt.py)
discovered_via: archive.org advancedsearch/metadata API over the gazetteofindia collection (mirror of egazette.gov.in); the PDF itself was downloaded from egazette.gov.in
text_caveat: machine conversion of a Gazette PDF; as published, not consolidated; marginal notes rendered as "Section N — heading" lines; unruled tables split on column gaps; Devanagari text omitted
text_held_back: Not deposited in the repository: this is the text of an Act of Parliament. India publishes no reuse licence for Acts; Copyright Act 1957 s.52(1)(q)(ii) permits reproducing or publishing an Act only together with commentary or other original matter. Re-use is conditional, not clearly permitted, so the converted text is staged outside the repository pending a human decision.
